stilusok.miert: Tiszta, modern lapos ikonok a narancs és borostyán színekkel. Rendezett, jól olvasható.
stilusok.elotag: Modern flat vector icon, calm rounded geometric shapes, bold simple solid shapes, no gradients, no outlines, no 3D. Limited palette only: {primary}, {accent}, {accent2}, with tiny {ink} details. Serene, mature, wellness mood.

stilusok.miert: A mostani oldalatok vékony narancs vonalas ikonjainak igényesebb változata, egy-egy meleg színfolttal mögöttük.
stilusok.elotag: Minimal monoline line-art icon: uniform medium-weight {primary} strokes with rounded caps, plus one soft flat colour blob in {accent} slightly offset behind the line drawing like a misregistered print. Clean, editorial, calm, lots of white space.

stilusok.miert: Laza, kézzel rajzolt ikonok, mintha Kirana rajzolta volna a jegyzetei margójára. Személyes, meleg.
stilusok.elotag: Hand-drawn ink brush icon drawn in {accent2}: loose, slightly imperfect organic lines, simple flat colour washes in {primary} and {accent} that slightly miss the outlines. Calm sketchbook style, mature and gentle, not childish.

stilusok.miert: Puha, matt, agyagszerű 3D formák meleg fényben. Prémium, kézzelfogható, nyugodt.
stilusok.elotag: Soft 3D clay-style icon: rounded smooth matte shapes, warm gentle candle-like light from the top left, soft ambient occlusion, colours based on {primary}, {accent} and {accent2}. No harsh reflections, no floor. Calm, premium wellness mood.

stilusok.miert: Kétszínű, szemcsés risograph-nyomat: karakteres, kicsit művészi, plakátos.
stilusok.elotag: Retro two-colour risograph print icon: bold simple forms in {primary} and {accent2} inks only, visible grain texture and slight misregistration, flat, no gradients. Calm, mature mood.

ikonok.tema: an open eye seen from the front with a few soft radiating lines above it, symbol of attention and presence
three flowing curved air waves, like a slow calm breath, symbol of breathing
two open hands gently touching at the fingertips, symbol of mindful touch
a single elegant flame, symbol of inner energy
a smooth gentle wave line inside a circle, like a calm controlled flow of energy
a classic hourglass with sand flowing, symbol of time and patience
